LanguageData.RHA_F026_Help1: Absorbs 70% of non-explosive damage within a 120-degree frontal arc, using a finite shield that does not regenerate. Flanks, rear attacks and explosions bypass it. Stun and broken poise disable it. Short lines mark the arc; the long line previews a turn that completes after 1.5 seconds.
LanguageData.RHA_F026_Help2: Three repairs per deployment. Channels for 3 seconds to repair up to 30 injury points on a visible ally within 10 cells from the same encounter. Cannot repair other anchors, dead or downed units. Stun, broken poise, blocked sight and range can interrupt it.
LanguageData.RHA_F026_Help3: Locks a visible colonist location within 30 cells, then strikes a 2.5-cell area after 3 seconds. Move out of the yellow ring to evade. Stun, broken poise, blocked sight and departure interrupt the charge.
LanguageData.RHA_F026_Preview: With challenge rules enabled, tier 3–5 trials and ruins deploy shield advances or anchor escorts. Flanking, explosives, interrupts and attacking support units can break these formations.
